operating_notes.text: Raised ₹200 crore in Tier II capital with a 7-year tenure to expand IGL and WASH lending.
GNPA 3.12% and NNPA 0.85% at March 2026; provision ratio 72.85%
Standalone debt-equity ratio 3.07 times at March 2026
Satin Housing Finance complied with PBC requirement at 63.52% of total assets as of March 31, 2026
On-book GNPA 3.12% (₹297 Cr) with provisions ₹273 Cr (2.9% of portfolio) vs RBI requirement ₹172 Cr and ₹20.5 Cr management overlay at March 2026.
Borrowing mix standalone: 70% banks, 14% overseas, 11% DFIs, 5% NBFCs; 75 active lenders, 9 added in FY26.
Satin Finserv green finance disbursed 34 loans worth ₹256 Cr in FY26.
Allotted 8,446 subordinated unsecured NCDs of face value ₹1,00,000 each aggregating ₹84.46 Cr.
Allotted up to 2,000 secured, rated, listed, redeemable USD-denominated NCDs of USD 10,000 face value each, aggregating up to USD 20,000,000, privately placed with BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund.
Trishashna Holdings & Investments Private Limited holds 3,79,14,820 shares (34.32%) pre-issue, rising to 4,17,64,820 (36.53%) post-preferential allotment.
Board approved issuing up to 38,50,000 fully convertible warrants to promoter Trishashna Holdings at ₹260 each, aggregating ₹100.10 Cr.
Active borrower base surpassed 34 lakh clients across 2,075 branches.
Undrawn funding sanctions stood at ~₹4,600 crore with liquidity at ₹2,235 crore as of September 30, 2026.
Category II AIF subsidiary SGAL achieved first close in 4.5 months and made its first investment.

timeline.summary: Satin Creditcare approved the issuance of up to USD 20 million in secured USD-denominated bonds.
Satin Creditcare raised ₹200 crore in subordinated Tier II capital with a 7-year tenure.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹919.5 Cr, net profit ₹162.05 Cr (+640.3% YoY).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹923 Cr, PAT ₹162 Cr (+640.5% YoY); FY26 PAT ₹332 Cr, AUM ₹15,174 Cr (+18.7%).
Satin Creditcare Network Limited uploaded Q4 and FY2026 earnings call audio on May 12, 2026, via Vikas Gupta, Company Secretary.
Satin Creditcare reported Q4FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹162 Cr on May 12, 2026, with full-year AUM crossing ₹15,174 Cr.
On May 15, 2026, Satin Creditcare's working committee approved a subordinated NCD issue of up to ₹84.46 crore at a 12.80% coupon.
On May 26, 2026, Satin Creditcare allotted 8,446 subordinated NCDs aggregating ₹84.46 crore.

On May 27, 2026, Satin Creditcare's Working Committee allotted up to 2,000 secured, rated, listed USD-denominated NCDs of USD 10,000 each, aggregating up to USD 20,000,000, on a private placement basis to BlueOrchard Microfinance Fund.

On June 04, 2026, Satin Creditcare's board approved issuing up to 38,50,000 fully convertible warrants to promoter Trishashna Holdings at ₹260 each, aggregating ₹100.10 Cr, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.
On June 4, 2026, Satin Creditcare announced a ₹100.10 crore preferential issue of convertible warrants to promoter Trishashna Holdings at ₹260 per share.
ICRA reaffirmed Satin Creditcare Network's [ICRA]A (Stable) and [ICRA]A1 ratings, assigning an enhanced fund-based limit of ₹5,500 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹925.84 Cr, net profit ₹175.9 Cr (+230.9% YoY).
Satin Creditcare reported Q2FY27 consolidated PAT of ₹176 Cr (+231% YoY) with AUM growing 31% YoY to ₹16,589 Cr.
Audio recording of Q2/H1 FY27 Earnings Call held on October 29, 2026 uploaded on company website.
